verdict: Leads are up, but Google spend is running without recording results.
narrative: You received 133 leads this period at a cost of $21.52 per lead, all of them coming through Meta. Google Ads consumed $1,599.71 — 56% of total spend — and recorded zero leads, because call conversions are not currently mapping through to your lead system. As a result, your cost per lead rose nearly 24% week-over-week even as lead volume grew 31%, meaning the efficiency loss is entirely tied to untracked Google spend, not Meta performance. We are repairing the conversion tracking on the Google side so that spend is accountable going forward. With that fix underway alongside new landing pages and offline conversion import both scheduled by end of August, Google should begin contributing measurable leads next period.
